Experience working in a medical setting with physicians, patients, and staff.
Provide high-level administrative support to faculty, exercising independent judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive matters.
Manage complex calendars and coordinate faculty schedules, internal and external professional activities, academic activities, leave, vacations, and schedule changes.
Serve as a professional liaison between faculty, staff, UCI/UC Irvine Health departments, physicians, community organizations, and external partners.

Coordinate all aspects of Independent Medical Examinations (IMEs), including attorney communication, scheduling, time tracking, patient coordination, and invoicing for professional, technical, and expert witness services.
Coordinate VIP visits and local, national, and international travel, including itineraries, accommodations, transportation, clinic schedules, conferences, visas, and registrations.
Plan and coordinate meetings and events, including facilities, conference rooms, equipment, catering, parking, and communications.

Serve as the initial point of contact for physicians, faculty, staff, community organizations, and external partners, providing responsive and professional communication by phone, email, and correspondence.
Maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive faculty, and departmental information in accordance with HIPAA and university policies.
Maintain and archive service-line photographs and videos in compliance with HIPAA requirements.
Track and maintain physician licensure, certifications, DEA registrations, professional memberships, training, occupational health requirements, and continuing medical education (CME).
Maintain and update faculty CVs and biosketches, including presentations, awards, honors, grants, publications, and other professional activities.
Assist with faculty teaching, research lectures, academic activities, and coordination with residency program staff.
Prepare and coordinate a variety of academic, medical, administrative, and professional correspondence and materials.
Support the Administrative Supervisor and respond independently to a wide range of departmental requests and priorities.
Maintain organized records and ensure timely completion of recurring administrative and compliance requirements.
Thorough knowledge of administrative procedures and processes including word processing, spreadsheet and database applications.
Requires good verbal and written communication skills, active listening, critical thinking, multi-tasking and time management skills.
Skill in managing sensitive and confidential information regarding bargaining unit issues.
Requires interpersonal and work leadership skills to provide guidance to other nonexempt personnel.
Demonstrated proficiency using software, including Microsoft Office; Word and Excel for word-processing. Ability to utilize resources.
Demonstrated ability to use the copier, FAX machine, Zoom meetings, conference lines and transcription equipment.
